import json,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
print("phase=independent_reduction_start completed=0 pending=1",flush=True)
p=Path(sys.argv[1]);ref=json.loads(p.read_bytes());v=json.loads(Path(ref["path"]).read_bytes());r=v["reduction"];m=json.loads(Path(v["manifest"]["path"]).read_bytes())
sources=[json.loads(x) for x in Path(m["files"]["sources"]["path"]).read_text().splitlines()];responses=[json.loads(x) for x in Path(m["files"]["responses"]["path"]).read_text().splitlines()]
ids={s["source_id"] for s in sources if s["task_type"] in {"QA","Summary"}};exposed={json.loads(x)["source_id"] for w in m["exposure_witnesses"] for x in Path(w["path"]).read_text().splitlines()}
assert ids<=exposed and len(ids)==1932
natural=[x for x in responses if x["source_id"] in ids];origin=r["annotation_origin_rows"][0]
assert len(natural)==origin["response_count"]==11592
assert sum(len(x["labels"]) for x in natural)==origin["span_count"]==4999
assert sum(bool(x["labels"]) for x in natural)==origin["response_error_count"]
assert dict(Counter(c for x in natural for c in {s["label_type"] for s in x["labels"]}))==origin["category_response_counts"]
assert {s for g in r["source_group_rows"] for s in g["source_ids"]}==ids
assert len(r["source_group_rows"])==r["human_authority_group_count"]==1823
assert r["independent_count"]==r["completed_count"]==len(r["role_manifest"])==0
assert r["censored_count"]==600 and r["excluded_count"]==1823
assert r["intended_count"]==r["completed_count"]+r["excluded_count"]+r["censored_count"]+r["failed_count"]
assert all(row["status"] in {"excluded","censored"} for row in r["rows"])
print(json.dumps(dict(passed=True,natural_source_ids=len(ids),exposed_source_ids=len(ids&exposed),natural_responses=len(natural),human_spans=origin["span_count"],group_components=len(r["source_group_rows"]),unseen_groups=0,code_sha256=hashlib.sha256(sys.argv[2].encode()).hexdigest())),flush=True)
print("phase=independent_reduction_complete completed=1 pending=0",flush=True)
